findings.message: ByTitle now builds the SQL query by concatenating the user-supplied term directly into the statement (WHERE title = '<term>') and executes it without parameters. This reintroduces a SQL injection vulnerability; an attacker can inject arbitrary SQL via the search term (e.g., a quote followed by UNION/DROP statements).
findings.suggestion: Revert to parameterized query: query := "SELECT id, sku, title FROM products WHERE title = $1"; rows, err := s.db.Query(query, term)
